_readme: Vendor-run sale promos shown on suppliers.html as a 'Vendor sale' row, separate from our affiliate code (vendor_config.json promo_code stays OUR code). Format: {"<vendor>": [{"code": "WEBACK30", "gives": "30% off", "start": null, "end": null, "exclusions": null, "combines_with_our_code": null, "source": "midwestpeptide.com homepage banner", "verified": "2026-09-30"}]}. Fill fields ONLY from the vendor's own site, terms, or email; leave a field null when unconfirmed. A sale with a past 'end' (UTC, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ) is hidden automatically at render time, like price_overrides expiry. Embedded into suppliers.html as const VENDOR_SALES by scripts/sync_vendor_config.py. Jackson approves every entry before it is added.
